4284-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Clone by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-4050-4446.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1011-2728-3967-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-3967-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-3967-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1887-2021-2060-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
1887-2021-2060-7803.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

443-1580-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

277-3678-6681-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
There's another land on the battlefield.
277-3678-6681-6879.description:
Play Strip Mine.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Strip Mine.
Activate Strip Mine's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting another land.
Haru triggers, returning Strip Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Strip Mine.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
277-3678-6681-6879.notes: You can use this combo as a lock, destroying any lands you wish as they enter. To do this combo infinitely, simply target the same land each loop while keeping the Strip Mine abilities on the stack.

513-3365-6896.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-3365-6896.description:
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

457-1792-3836-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-3836-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Urza, Lord Protector
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

465-997-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

775-1409-6751.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve both Jewel Thief triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2464-3459-4311-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3459-4311-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

643-1486-5433--119.easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
643-1486-5433--119.description:
Tap a creature using any method.
Magda triggers, as the creature is a Dwarf due to Maskwood Nexus, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token and giving it haste until end of turn.
Repeat, tapping the Goblin instead.
643-1486-5433--119.notes: The method used to tap creatures must be usable for all creatures you control for the loop to continue. You may use Krenko (or Magda if it doesn't have summoning sickness) to start the combo if they're untapped. Some methods may overt the summoning sickness requirement (like Earthcraft, for example).

1879-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1879-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

123-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Highspire Artisan.
When Highspire Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Highspire Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

338-589-2428.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-589-2428.description:
Gain life.
Fathom Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-3689-6518-6747.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1491-2033-2265-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2033-2265-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2033-2265-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1263-4050-6462.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat

997-1052-6553.easyPrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
997-1052-6553.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5231-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5231-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

64-1170-2196-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
64-1170-2196-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

2060-3525-3574-6260.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3525-3574-6260.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3525-3574-6260.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

527-3499-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-3499-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

539-1636-3136-3346-4147.notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
539-1636-3136-3346-4147.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Changeling Outcast.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Changeling Outcast on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Changeling Outcast and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Changeling Outcast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

618-3320-4486.description:
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, causing creatures you control to have base power and toughness 1/1 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goatnapper with haste.
The Goatnapper token enters the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat from step 2.

2409-2440-3781-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional Insect creatures.
2409-2440-3781-5147.description:
Cast Needlebug from your graveyard by paying {4}.
Needlebug enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Needlebug.
Needlebug dies, triggering Zask.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1 any number of times.
Resolve a Zask trigger, milling two cards.
Resolve a Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat the last two steps any number of times.

549-1740-4050-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
Biotransference triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and create a 2/2 Necron Warrior token.
Leonin Relic-Warder's ETB ability triggers, exiling Extraction Specialist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding one mana of any color.
Leonin Relic-Warder's LTB ability triggers, returning Extraction Specialist from exile to the battlefield.
Extraction Specialist enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-3233-4120-4629.description:
Cast Saving Grace by paying {1}{W}.
Saving Grace enters the battlefield attached to Crystalline Crawler, triggering itself, causing all damage that would be dealt to you or permanents you control this turn to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Saving Grace's ability redirects damage to Crystalline Crawler, which results in at least three +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least once by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {R}.
Repeat from step 3.
